how_to_apply: Applications are made online under 'Openings' on the Institute website, through the staff recruitment portal. The hard copy then goes by post. These are the steps the notice gives:
Register and create a User ID and Password on the staff recruitment portal. Online applications can be submitted until 17:00 hrs on 11 November 2026.

Fill in the online application form completely and submit it. The form has six stages. You may save and edit before final submission, but no changes are permitted after final submission. Upload complete details of all qualifications and experience, with the supporting documents.
After final submission, the payment information is displayed. Click "Proceed for Payment" to reach the SBI Payment Gateway.

Pay the fee of ₹500 through UPI, Internet Banking, Credit Card or Debit Card, and do not click "Refresh" or "Back". SC/ST/PwD/Women/Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from the fee and must upload proof. The fee is not refundable, and applications without fee payment are not accepted.

After a successful payment you are redirected to the portal, which shows a confirmation. An email confirmation is also sent. If money is deducted but the transaction fails, recheck the status after 30 minutes. For payment issues, write to [email protected].

Send the hard copy of the completed application with self-attested copies of the certificates by Registered/Speed Post, in a sealed cover superscribed "Application for the post of ______, Post Code ______". Address it to The Registrar, IISER Thiruvananthapuram, Maruthamala P.O, Vithura, Thiruvananthapuram - 695551.

The hard copy must reach the Institute by 17:00 hrs on 18 November 2026. Online applications are considered only if the hard copy arrives on or before the last date. The Institute is not responsible for postal delays.

A candidate applying for more than one post must send a separate hard copy of the application for each post. Candidates employed in Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous Bodies/PSUs must apply through proper channel and upload the No Objection Certificate (NOC) and Vigilance Clearance Certificate (VCC) issued by their current employer. They may send advance copies of the application with all enclosures.
Self-attested copies of certificates for educational qualifications, date of birth, experience and category claims (with the hard copy)
Experience certificates on the organisation's letterhead, in the format described above
Equivalency certificate from the present employer, for claims of equivalent pay

OBC-NCL certificate in the prescribed Government of India format, for OBC-NCL candidates applying against the OBC-NCL post. It must be valid as on the last date of submission of the application (or as per GoI rules in force) and issued during the current or immediately preceding financial year. The valid certificate must be produced at joining, if selected.
Disability Certificate issued as per the PwD Act, 1995 and the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 (to be uploaded by PwD candidates)
NOC and VCC from the current employer, for candidates in Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous Bodies/PSUs
important_instructions: Applications that are incomplete, not supported by the required documents, photograph or application fee, or submitted after the deadline will be summarily rejected. Candidates must disclose any penalties or punishments imposed on them, and any disciplinary or inquiry proceedings started against them. If any information a candidate gives is found to be false or incorrect at any stage, the candidature or appointment will be cancelled or terminated. Canvassing or bringing any influence in any form will lead to disqualification. No TA/DA is paid for attending the selection process. The decision of the competent authority is final and binding in all matters of recruitment. This includes eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, equivalence of qualifications or experience, shortlisting criteria and selection method.

content_sections.heading: About IISER Thiruvananthapuram
content_sections.text: The notice describes the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Thiruvananthapuram (IISER TVM) as an Institute of National Importance. It is located at Maruthamala PO, Vithura, Thiruvananthapuram - 695551, Kerala, India, and its letterhead gives the phone number 0471-2778031.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be citizens of India. The notice encourages candidates from across the country to apply, and particularly encourages female candidates. The qualifications and experience below are minimum requirements. Qualifications, experience and age limit are considered as on the closing date of online submission of the application. Apprenticeship, training and similar engagements are not counted as experience. Educational qualification: Master's Degree in Library Science/Library and Information Science with 55% marks from a recognized University. OR Master's Degree in any discipline plus a Bachelor's degree in Library Science/Library and Information Science with 55% marks from a recognized University. Experience: 5 years of experience in the field of Library & Information Science in Pay Level-6 or above in Digital Library Management / Library Automation and Library Networking in Central / State Govt. / Semi-Govt. / Govt. Autonomous Organizations / Govt. Universities / Institutions of Higher Education with Master's Degree in Library Science/Library and Information Science with 55% marks from a recognized University. Desirable: Diploma/Certificate in Computer Application/ Digital Library Management/ Library Automation from a recognized Institute or enough working experience in Library Digitization and Library Networking. Essential qualification and experience: 5 years of experience in Pay Level-6 or above as Technical Assistant or equivalent posts, or 11 years of experience in Pay Level-5 or above as Junior Technical Assistant or equivalent posts, in relevant fields in software development/hardware/system administration/IT and networking/AV/AI/Data Science and Engineering etc. in reputed organizations/universities, with B.E. /B.Tech. /Diploma in Engineering of 3 Years duration/ MCA or M.Sc/ B.S-M.S with at least 55% or equivalent in appropriate field. Desirable: Qualifications and experience/expertise in the field of Instrumentation / Electronics. Educational qualification: Bachelor's Degree with at least 55% marks in any discipline with excellent computer proficiency in Office Applications like Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc. Experience: 5 years of relevant experience in handling office works & equipment/knowledge of computer applications/hospitality management/in any Central/State Govt. or similar organized services/Semi-Govt./PSU/Govt. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All 8 posts are filled on a regular basis. They follow Central Government pay scales under the 7th CPC: Pay Level 7 for Library Superintendent and Senior Technical Assistant (Technical), and Pay Level 5 for Office Assistant (Multi-Skill), Junior Technical Assistant (Scientific) and Junior Technical Assistant (Technical). The posts carry the usual allowances such as DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, etc. The posts are covered under the New Pension Scheme (NPS) of the National Pension System, with benefits such as Medical Reimbursement, LTC, etc., as per Government of India norms. Service conditions are governed by the NITSER Act and the IISER Statutes issued from time to time, and they are binding on the selected candidates. If required at a later stage, the Institute reserves the right to revise, regularise or modify pay scales and other service conditions based on decisions of the Board of Governors.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process is a written examination of two hours with objective-type questions, each with only one correct answer. The notice describes this written examination and does not mention an interview. Shortlisting: Meeting the minimum qualifications does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called. If many applications are received, the Institute may restrict the number of candidates called, based on higher qualifications/experience in Government sectors and/or other criteria. Shortlist and communication: The list of candidates shortlisted for the written examination will be published on the Institute website. Successful candidates will also be notified by email, and no other communication will be issued. Candidates must give a working email ID and mobile number. Syllabus: The syllabus is sent to the shortlisted candidates by email. The paper setters decide the weightage for each topic. Question papers are not disclosed, because they form a question bank for future recruitment. Original documents: Shortlisted candidates must produce original documents for reservation, educational qualification, date of birth, experience, etc., before the selection process. Those who do not are not allowed to take part. Employed candidates must produce the NOC and VCC at the written examination, or their candidature will be rejected. Tie in marks: If two candidates get the same marks in the written examination, the older candidate is placed higher in merit, as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IISER Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: Library Superintendent (1), Senior Technical Assistant (Technical) (1), Office Assistant (Multi-Skill) (3), Junior Technical Assistant (Scientific) (2) and Junior Technical Assistant (Technical) (1).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IISER Thiruvananthapuram non-teaching posts?
faq.answer: The online application closes at 17:00 hrs on 11 November 2026. The hard copy with all documents must reach the Institute by 17:00 hrs on 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IISER TVM Office Assistant (Multi-Skill)?
faq.answer: The post needs a Bachelor's Degree with at least 55% marks in any discipline, with excellent computer proficiency in Office Applications like Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc. It also needs 5 years of relevant experience in handling office works & equipment/knowledge of computer applications/hospitality management in Government or similar organisations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IISER Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 38 years for Library Superintendent and Senior Technical Assistant (Technical), and 33 years for Office Assistant (Multi-Skill) and both Junior Technical Assistant posts. Relaxation applies as per Government of India rules, and Institute employees have no upper age limit if at least one year of service remains.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for IISER TVM non-teaching posts?
faq.answer: Library Superintendent and Senior Technical Assistant (Technical) are at 7th CPC Pay Level 7, and the three Group C posts are at Pay Level 5. All posts carry the usual allowances such as DA, HRA and Transport Allowance, etc.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for IISER Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹500, paid online through the SBI Payment Gateway, and it is not refundable. SC/ST/PwD/Women/Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted and must upload proof.

faq.question: Q7. How is the selection made for IISER TVM non-teaching posts?
faq.answer: Selection is through a two-hour written examination with objective-type questions. The Institute may shortlist candidates for it based on higher qualifications/experience in Government sectors and/or other criteria, and it sends the syllabus to shortlisted candidates by email.

faq.question: Q8. Are the IISER Thiruvananthapuram non-teaching posts permanent?
faq.answer: The posts are advertised on a regular basis under 7th CPC Central Government pay scales. They are covered under the New Pension Scheme (NPS).

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post at IISER Thiruvananthapuram?
faq.answer: Yes. A candidate who applies for more than one post must send a separate hard copy of the application for each post.

faq.question: Q10. What should be written on the envelope for the IISER TVM hard copy application?
